title: What happens if you stop drinking water?
description:
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.
#health #body #water #science

lines.hook: What happens if you stop drinking water?
lines.d1: Day one. Your mouth dries out, and your head starts pounding.
lines.d2: Day two. Your kidneys slow down to save every last drop.
lines.d2b: Your blood gets thicker, so your heart has to beat faster.
lines.d3: Day three. You stop sweating, and your body starts to overheat.
lines.d4: Day four. Your brain starts to shrink.
lines.d4b: And you begin to see things that aren't there.
lines.d5: Day five. Your kidneys start to fail, and toxins build up in your blood.
lines.d6: Day six. Your organs start shutting down. Most people never make it this far.
lines.end: Your body is about sixty percent water. So when did you last drink a glass?
